verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a first-party Triggers feature for setting up 'complex workflows and automations', and users can create triggers from premade templates or from scratch, so rule-based automation exists in the product itself. The evidence does not show which events can fire a trigger, what conditions can be set, or which actions can run, so complete coverage of event-driven rules is unproven. Webhooks are outbound event callbacks, an adjacent feature, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: documented catalog of trigger events, condition/rule logic details, list of executable actions (including AI-agent actions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set up complex workflows and automations to execute your business processes
Once you hit "create trigger" you'll have the option to select from various premade templates or start from scratch.
